["pro-method-analogy-closed-worldview","29:33",76,"Major direct reply","White argues Price’s analogy principle excludes divine action before evidence is heard, so rival historical methods should instead be compared for consistent evidential treatment.","It directly targets Price’s stated method while exposing the debate’s competing background commitments","Price distinguishes disciplinary restraint from metaphysical denial, so White has not established that the method secretly assumes naturalism","Specify public criteria admitting divine explanations without equally crediting every coherent miracle tradition"],

["pro-consistent-testing-of-miracles","43:58",81,"Supporting reply","White distinguishes admitting supernatural claims from believing them, proposing consistent historical comparison and citing his critical treatment of Joseph Smith’s First Vision.","The Mormon comparison concretely demonstrates that supernatural admissibility need not entail credulous acceptance","Consistency remains underdefined, and internal fit with a religious message cannot independently establish extraordinary events","State cross-tradition criteria for independence, alternatives, probability, and corroboration, then apply them evenly"],

["pro-consistency-as-truth-test","2:11:04",76,"Major direct reply","White closes by treating both approaches as worldview-laden and asks listeners to compare their consistency rather than imagine Price’s criticism is entirely presupposition-free.","It fairly acknowledges White’s commitment while challenging the pretense that Price occupies neutral interpretive ground","Internal consistency cannot define truth because elaborate false systems may remain coherent despite external factual failure","Connect scriptural coherence to independently constrained evidence and explain how counterexamples avoid ad hoc harmonization"],
["con-ancient-history-provisional","52:59",84,"Supporting reply","Price makes historical confidence decline with temporal distance and evidential scarcity, contrasting ancient uncertainty with massively corroborated modern events such as Dachau.","It offers calibrated, revisable historical knowledge rather than either dogmatic certainty or total skepticism","Temporal distance is only a proxy, and the particular New Testament evidence receives little individualized analysis","Apply the probability standard to the strongest biblical sources by quantity, independence, genre, and preservation"],
["pro-hadith-temporal-difference","1:11:23",80,"Supporting reply","White rejects Price’s Hadith analogy because major collections arose centuries after Muhammad, unlike the comparatively early documentary foundation he attributes to New Testament writings.","It identifies temporal distance as a genuine disanalogy that weakens any simple transmission equivalence","The argument presupposes White’s dating and undercompares oral layers, community controls, attribution incentives, and intermediary evidence","Defend Gospel dates and demonstrate that shorter distance actually prevented pious attribution rather than merely limiting opportunity"],
["con-eyewitness-suppression-speculative","9:11",81,"Load-bearing constructive","Price argues that imagining vigilant disciples suppressing invented reports is not evidence they successfully policed tradition, and reasoning backward from desired reliability is circular.","It precisely separates a possible eyewitness safeguard from evidence of comprehensive operation across dispersed communities","The move remains negative and gives little affirmative evidence about actual correction or partial witness constraint","Map circulation, named witnesses, competing communities, and correction episodes to estimate the mechanism’s genuine reach"],
["pro-common-phrase-not-literary-borrowing","1:23:17",85,"Supporting reply","White argues that “kicking against the goads” was conventional Greek expression, so shared wording cannot establish that Acts borrowed its conversion narrative from literature.","It attacks diagnostic force with earlier usages and an accessible ordinary-idiom analogy","Refuting one phrase does not answer Price’s claimed Heliodorus and Pentheus parallels in plot and sequence","Compare the strongest narrative correspondences and test common motif, independent narration, and direct dependence"],
["con-existence-evidence-criterion","1:32:03",80,"Supporting reply","Price names a modest contemporaneous eyewitness letter as evidence that would change his mind, while treating the Gospel residue as too myth-shaped for confidence.","It defeats unfalsifiability by naming persuasive evidence and explicitly keeping nonexistence tentative","A surviving personal letter may be an unusually stringent baseline for a provincial ancient figure","Justify why Pauline, Gospel, non-Christian, and reception evidence collectively fails more ordinary historical criteria"],
["con-orality-variation-not-verbatim","1:37:21",82,"Supporting reply","Price invokes Parry and Lord to argue oral recitation is fresh performance with flexible wording and order, not verbatim preservation of an original.","It supplies a research-based model where thematic continuity coexists with substantial recomposition","Balkan epic performance may not map directly onto short teachings, catechesis, controversies, or early Christian communities","Show which Jesus traditions fit that model and what semantic content the analogy predicts would remain stable"],
["pro-composition-inconsistent-source-theory","31:22",63,"Supporting constructive","White announces that Price’s authorship and transmission theory is undemonstrated and conflicts with consistent interpretation, but initially supplies only a roadmap for later support.","It identifies authorial coherence and manuscript compatibility as two relevant constraints upon Price’s reconstruction","The categorical incapability claim arrives before any specific inconsistency or documentary contradiction is demonstrated","Supply passage-level comparisons and dated transmission evidence addressing Price’s strongest proposed literary seams"],
["con-cosmopolitan-source-availability","55:58",80,"Supporting reply","Price argues diaspora Judaism’s cosmopolitan setting made scriptural and Greek literary materials jointly available, so mixed source use by Gospel authors remains culturally coherent.","It defeats a strict Jewish-versus-Greek dichotomy through concrete artistic, literary, biblical, and Maccabean examples","Availability is not dependence, and examples from different regions and periods may not represent particular evangelists","Date and connect each comparator, then demonstrate distinctive correspondences and plausible authorial access"],
["pro-jewish-monotheism-against-pagan-myth","1:02:41",79,"Major direct reply","White argues early Jewish monotheism makes a pagan dying-god template implausible, while Price’s strongest archaeological examples substantially postdate Jesus and Jerusalem’s destruction.","It challenges Price on both ideological suitability and the chronology of his material examples","First-century Judaism was diverse, and resistance cannot exclude selective adaptation or polemical transformation","Document relevant pre-seventy communities and explain early Christology without pagan templates or analogous Jewish development"],
["con-pauline-internal-discontinuity","1:18:03",74,"Supporting reply","Price cites tensions about divine knowledge and women speaking as internal evidence that Pauline letters contain editorial layers rather than one continuous authorial context.","It replaces unavailable variant manuscripts with concrete thematic and disciplinary tensions inside First Corinthians","The compressed contrasts omit rhetoric, quotation, audience questions, and distinctions among kinds of speech","Demonstrate contextual reconciliation fails and interpolation better predicts the exact wording and placement"],
["pro-context-explains-authorial-variation","1:19:25",82,"Supporting reply","White uses Price’s differently styled books to show audience, genre, and context can explain variation without requiring separate authors or later textual interpolation.","Price’s own contextual explanation makes the common-authorship analogy memorable and directly responsive","The analogy proves possibility but does not supply the actual missing context for ancient Corinthian tensions","Reconstruct those contexts from the letter and explain every cited discontinuity without improvised rescue"],
["con-pauls-conversion-literary-parallels","1:22:37",68,"Supporting reply","Price treats Paul’s silence about the Damascus road and alleged Heliodorus and Pentheus parallels as evidence that Acts constructed the detailed conversion scene.","It combines named literary comparators with the genuine absence of Acts’ detailed narrative from Paul’s letters","Epistles need not retell biography, and Price never displays enough distinctive correspondence to establish dependence","Present ordered parallels, prove access, exclude conventional motifs, and reconcile Paul’s brief revelation language"],

["pro-manuscript-streams-against-interpolation","39:41",86,"Major direct reply","White argues independently branching manuscript streams would preserve First Corinthians versions without verses 3–11 if that passage entered only through later interpolation.","It creates a concrete historical prediction from textual diversity and the observed tenacity of variant readings","An insertion before recoverable branching could still produce unanimous later witnesses despite an earlier alternate form","Date branch points and quantify expected survival under competing early and late insertion models"],
["con-paul-distortion-gnostic-reception","18:16",75,"Supporting constructive","Price notes Paul was misrepresented during his lifetime and disputed writings gained ancient followers, undermining confidence that contemporaries reliably suppressed distorted Christian traditions.","It supplies counterexamples to idealized policing through Pauline complaints and divided reception of disputed writings","Existing misrepresentation alongside correction does not show central claims were permanently replaced or lost","Demonstrate durable corruption and connect the cited communities to the canonical transmission streams under review"],
["pro-no-standardization-manuscript-variation","59:39",86,"Major direct reply","White argues unusually varied early papyri contradict a centralized Christian standardization capable of erasing every First Corinthians witness lacking the disputed resurrection passage.","It answers Price’s escape route with the observable diversity expected from uncontrolled independent copying","Post-standardization diversity cannot exclude every earlier editorial convergence before surviving genealogical branches","Connect measured variation to independence predating the alleged insertion and exclude a localized common archetype"],
["con-interpolation-internal-fit","1:44:12",80,"Major direct reply","Price argues First Corinthians 15:3–11 interrupts the resurrection treatise and combines rival apostolic credential lists, offering internal evidence of a later editorial compromise.","It identifies changed function, grouped credentials, named factions, and apparent redundancy as inspectable literary evidence","Paul’s announced gospel gives the passage plausible structural purpose, while expanded lists need not combine rivals","Show the chapter reads better without it and justify overriding unanimous transmission with internal reconstruction"],

["con-mission-sayings-community-products","24:50",75,"Load-bearing constructive","Price links Matthew’s opposed mission instructions to Jewish-only and Gentile-supporting communities, while conceding that a plausible fabrication mechanism does not prove actual fabrication.","It connects identifiable texts to an early controversy while carefully qualifying the resulting hypothesis","The Acts silence overlooks selective reporting, disputed interpretation, and changing mission stages","Answer White’s sequence, justify the silence inference, and connect each passage to its proposed constituency"],
["pro-scripture-comparative-coherence","2:12:42",76,"Major direct reply","White argues biblical claims differ fundamentally from Apollonius traditions in worldview and coherence, so admitting divine speech need not collapse every miracle account together.","It rejects the false choice between naturalistic exclusion and indiscriminate acceptance of every myth","The alleged superiority over Philostratus remains largely testimonial, unspecified, and insufficient to verify divine authorship","Provide paired comparisons and connect defined coherence measures to external historical truth"],
